snippet.title: Road Truckers: New Beginning PC & PS5 updated trailer - Truck-Sim RPG
snippet.description:
Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3333190?utm_source=yt
or on PlayStation 5: https://store.playstation.com/concept/10012597

Upcoming Road Truckers: New Beginning is an unusual combination of the truck-sim genre and RPG elements. In this game, you are not only a truck - you are a real trucker who needs to take care not only of his machine but also of himself.

Don't miss the upcoming playtest – wishlist and follow us on Steam now!
